12:     tau_filter: float,
13: ) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
14:     """Return an ordered keep mask and one finite margin per proposed call."""
15: 
16:     # Validate inputs
17:     for arr in [logp_with_result, logp_call_only, logp_no_call]:
18:         if not isinstance(arr, np.ndarray):
19:             raise ValueError("All inputs must be NumPy arrays")
20:         if arr.ndim != 2:
21:             raise ValueError("All inputs must be 2-dimensional")
22:         if arr.size == 0:
23:             raise ValueError("Inputs must not be empty")
24:         if not np.isfinite(arr).all():
25:             raise ValueError("All array values must be finite")
26:         if np.any(arr > 0):
27:             raise ValueError("All array values must be nonpositive")
28:     if not (logp_with_result.shape == logp_call_only.shape == logp_no_call.shape):
29:         raise ValueError("All input arrays must have the same shape")
30:     if isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
31:         raise ValueError("Threshold must not be a boolean")
32:     if not np.isfinite(tau_filter) or tau_filter < 0:
33:         raise ValueError("Threshold must be finite and nonnegative")
34: 
35:     # Compute per-candidate losses (negative sum of log probabilities)
36:     loss_with = -np.sum(logp_with_result, axis=1)
37:     loss_call = -np.sum(logp_call_only, axis=1)
38:     loss_no = -np.sum(logp_no_call, axis=1)
39: 
40:     # Margin: improvement over no-call baseline, taking the better of the two call scenarios
41:     margins = loss_no - np.minimum(loss_with, loss_call)
42:     keep = margins > tau_filter
